SELECT  "t0"."inv_number" AS "inv_number",
"t1"."description" AS "_discount_tier_id_description",
"t0"."id" AS "pkey"
 FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS t0
       LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_discount_tier" AS "t1" ON (
                ((:lo IS NULL AND :hi IS NOT NULL AND "t1"."min_amount"<=:hi) OR
                (:lo IS NOT NULL AND :hi IS NULL AND "t1"."min_amount">=:lo) OR
                (:lo IS NOT NULL AND :hi IS NOT NULL AND
                    "t1"."min_amount" >= :lo AND "t1"."min_amount" <= :hi) OR
                (:lo IS NULL AND :hi IS NULL))
            )
WHERE ("t0"."__del_ts" IS NULL)
